summary: Successfully created Purchase Order 4500066976 with single line item (Supplier: 17300002, Material: RMPI001, Quantity: 10 KG, Price: 0.08 USD)

steps.action: Navigate to SAP Fiori Launchpad URL
steps.expectedResult: SAP IDP login page is displayed with an email/username field
steps.actualResult: Redirected to https://accounts.sap.com/saml2/idp/sso - Email field pre-filled with sunil.yogi@capgemini.com

steps.action: Enter the user email address
steps.expectedResult: Email address is entered
steps.actualResult: Email address already pre-filled

steps.action: Click Continue button
steps.expectedResult: Page transitions to password entry screen
steps.actualResult: Password screen displayed with Password input field

steps.action: Enter user password
steps.expectedResult: Password is entered (masked)
steps.actualResult: Password entered successfully

steps.action: Click Continue button
steps.expectedResult: SAP authenticates and redirects to Fiori Launchpad home page
steps.actualResult: Successfully logged in - Fiori home page displayed (URL: #Shell-home, Title: Home)

steps.action: Dismiss Introduction/Welcome popup or Guided Tour
steps.expectedResult: Pop-up is dismissed; Fiori home page is fully visible
steps.actualResult: Guided Tour dialog appeared with 'Start Guided Tour' heading - dismissed using Escape key
steps.notes: Dialog was dismissed with keyboard Escape instead of clicking Leave Tour button

steps.action: Click search icon and type 'Manage Purchase Orders'
steps.expectedResult: Search results appear listing 'Manage Purchase Orders'
steps.actualResult: Search box opened, typed 'Manage Purchase Orders', search results dialog displayed with 1 result

steps.action: Click 'Manage Purchase Orders' in search results
steps.expectedResult: Application opens; Purchase Order list page is displayed
steps.actualResult: Navigated to Manage Purchase Orders app (URL: #PurchaseOrder-manage, Title: Manage Purchase Orders)

steps.action: Click Create button (Create PO) in application toolbar
steps.expectedResult: New Purchase Order creation form opens in edit/draft mode
steps.actualResult: Draft PO created (URL: IsActiveEntity=false, DraftUUID generated)

steps.action: Enter Supplier ID in Supplier header field
steps.expectedResult: Supplier ID is entered
steps.actualResult: Supplier ID '17300002' entered in textbox

steps.action: Press Enter to confirm Supplier entry
steps.expectedResult: SAP validates supplier; Supplier name 'Carbon Tec Inc.' auto-populated; Purchasing Org, Purchasing Group, Company Code auto-filled
steps.actualResult: Supplier validated successfully. Auto-populated: Purchasing Group = 'Group 001 (001)', Purchasing Organization = 'Purch. Org. 1710 (1710)', Company Code = 'Velotics Inc. (1710)'

steps.action: Click Create button in Items section
steps.expectedResult: A new empty line item row appears in Items table
steps.actualResult: New line item row created with empty fields (validation error shown: 'Please enter material number or account assignment category')

steps.action: Enter Material ID in Material field
steps.expectedResult: Material ID is entered
steps.actualResult: Material ID 'RMPI001' entered

steps.action: Press Enter to confirm Material entry
steps.expectedResult: SAP validates material; material description 'Input 1 (WATER)' and Unit of Measure 'KG' auto-populated
steps.actualResult: Material validated. Auto-populated: Unit of Measure = 'KG' (visible in Order Unit field)

steps.action: Enter order quantity
steps.expectedResult: Quantity is populated in line item
steps.actualResult: Order Quantity filled with '10' (displayed as '10.000' after formatting)

steps.action: Press Tab to move to Net Order Price field
steps.expectedResult: Cursor moves to Net Order Price field
steps.actualResult: Focus moved to Order Unit field (intermediate field), then to Net Order Price

steps.action: Enter price in Net Order Price field
steps.expectedResult: Price is populated; net total value is calculated and displayed
steps.actualResult: Price '0.08' entered. Net Order Value calculated automatically: 0.80 USD (10 × 0.08)

steps.action: Press Enter to confirm price entry
steps.expectedResult: Price is confirmed; line item net value is updated
steps.actualResult: Price confirmed. Line item fully configured except Plant.

steps.action: Enter Plant code
steps.expectedResult: Plant code is entered
steps.actualResult: Plant '1710' entered

steps.action: Press Enter to confirm Plant entry
steps.expectedResult: Plant is confirmed; line item is fully configured
steps.actualResult: Plant confirmed. Line item fully configured - validation warnings cleared.

steps.action: Click Order button in page footer
steps.expectedResult: SAP processes the PO submission
steps.actualResult: Order button clicked. PO submitted successfully.

steps.action: Observe on-screen response after clicking Order
steps.expectedResult: A success notification is displayed; system navigates to PO list or PO detail page
steps.actualResult: URL changed to IsActiveEntity=true (PO saved). Page title changed to '4500066976 (Standard PO) - Purchase Order'

steps.action: Note the generated Purchase Order number
steps.expectedResult: A unique 10-digit Purchase Order number (beginning with 45) is displayed
steps.actualResult: PO Number: 4500066976 (10 digits, starts with 45) ✓

steps.action: Click User Profile icon in top-right shell bar
steps.expectedResult: User profile menu appears
steps.actualResult: User menu dialog opened with 'Sign Out' button visible

steps.action: Click Sign Out
steps.expectedResult: Sign-out confirmation dialog appears
steps.actualResult: Confirmation dialog displayed: 'Are you sure you want to sign out?' with OK/Cancel buttons

steps.action: Click OK to confirm sign-out
steps.expectedResult: User is signed out; SAP login page is displayed
steps.actualResult: User signed out. Redirected to IDP logout page (HTTP 400 error is expected SAP behavior)

observations: SAP auto-population worked as expected for Supplier and Material fields
Net Order Value calculation verified (10 × 0.08 = 0.80 USD)
PO submission changed URL from IsActiveEntity=false to IsActiveEntity=true
Page title changed to include PO number after successful submission
Guided Tour dialog behavior: dismissed with Escape key instead of Leave Tour button
Sign out: IDP logout error (HTTP 400) is expected behavior for SAP single logout
